run_ETH3DWAI_dataset: run the ETH3D WAI dataset loader to sample views with images and depth maps
run_ETH3DWAI_viz: run the ETH3D dataset CLI with rerun visualization for 3D point clouds and cameras
create_ETH3DWAI_instance: create an ETH3DWAI dataset instance with a specific scene name and resolution
review_ETH3DWAI_get_views: review the ETH3DWAI _get_views method that loads and resizes image depth and pose data
review_ETH3DWAI_load_data: review the ETH3DWAI _load_data method that loads scene lists from numpy metadata files
